form.message: Project Fulcrum — revised Gate 1. The affected independent comprehensive Requirements review is APPROVED, low risk, with 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix and 0 suggestions; recording, schema and strict freshness checks passed. Approve the reviewed infrastructure-only, fictional-data dev requirements, including the already-authorized narrow Entra identity exception. Workload and non-Entra dependencies remain Sweden Central only; Entra's documented qualified European behavior is not an absolute EU-only guarantee.
